population.value: Patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) in sinus rhythm (SR) or atrial fibrillation (AF), with available rhythm analyses and after exclusion of patients with missing or paced rhythms

primary_findings.quote: empagliflozin reduced CVD or HHF compared to placebo in AF and SR (hazard ratio [HR] 0.82, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.63-1.08
primary_findings.outcome: Cardiovascular death (CVD) or hospitalization for heart failure (HHF) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF)
Cardiovascular death (CVD) or hospitalization for heart failure (HHF) in patients with sinus rhythm (SR)

primary_findings.quote: Incident AF was numerically lower but formally not significantly different (HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.40-1.09, p = 0.11, empagliflozin vs. placebo).
